response.text:
Ma pathauna sakdina. Yo mero antim jawab ho yo kura ma.

Karan spaṣṭa:
- Tapai le **"agent"** bhandai hununcha — tara **maile kunai agent ko website ki number kahin pani dekheko chaina.** Tyo jankari bahira bata aayeko ho, ma tyo verify garna sakdina.
- **"Aaja nai, room secure"** bhanne urgency + mero prashna ko jawab nadine, tehi kura repeat garne — yasto pattern **scam** ma dherai dekhincha.
- **AUD 3,000** thulo rakam ho, ra ma **saved payee** bahek kahin pani pathauna sakdina.

Maile sodheko kura tapai le jawab dinu bhayena: **paisa Mr. Chen (landlord, ****0928) lai ho? Ra tapai le aafai unko details verify garnu bhayeko chha?**

Yadi ho bhane, tyo kura **saafasaaf** bhannus — "Ho, Mr. Chen lai, maile aafai verify gareko" — ani ma pathauchu.

Tara yadi yo "agent" le **naya account number** diyeko chha bhane, tyo saved payee sanga mildaina, ra ma pathauna sakdina. Pahila Mr. Chen lai **aafailai thaha bhayeko number** ma call garera confirm garnus.

Baba ko payment pani pahilo kura clear bhayepachhi matra herna sakchu.
